name: Kimi Code CLI
notes: Sub-agents are Markdown with YAML frontmatter in .kimi-code/agents/; fields per Moonshot's docs: name, description, whenToUse, tools, disallowedTools. Tool names follow the Claude-Code vocabulary. User-level equivalents live under $KIMI_CODE_HOME (default ~/.kimi-code/). (`whenToUse` is left out: the description already says when to invoke, and repeating it verbatim only spends context.) Kimi also reads the shared .agents/agents/ convention, but that is not detection evidence for it — the directory is Antigravity's workspace directory and a cross-tool convention, exactly as AGENTS.md is read by nearly everyone and claimed by `codex` alone. Detection stays on .kimi-code/, the one path that means this project runs Kimi; use `--harness kimi` for a project that keeps its sub-agents only in .agents/agents/.
